checkpoints.description: [1/6] Product contract: tamper-evident audit evidence for AI agents, AGPL-3.0 core with commercial licensing path

impact_assessment.why: Companies deploying tool-using agents need defensible records for EU AI Act, ISO 42001 and customer audits; observability traces are not evidence.
impact_assessment.benefits: A local-first, zero-dependency evidence ledger plus policy findings and a self-contained pack gives buyers a 60-second proof and a clear enterprise upsell.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: hash-chain and event schema are compatibility surfaces; dependency: none beyond the Python standard library; concurrency: append-only single-writer ledger; state: HMAC key handling and PII retention.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Version every schema, document the threat model and format, fsync appends, keep keys out of argv/files, recommend WORM storage and PII minimization.

checkpoints.description: [2/6] Core evidence model: canonical event contract, contiguous SHA-256 chain, optional HMAC, tail-read append, tamper and truncation tests
[3/6] Policy engine: first-match rules, action globs, metadata conditions, amount thresholds, fail-closed missing amounts, policy digest binding and drift findings
[4/6] CLI and evidence packs: record, ingest generic/MCP, verify, review, report Markdown/JSON, demo, Error/Why/Fix triad and 0/1/2 exit codes
[5/6] Commercial surface: AGPL-3.0 LICENSE, packaging and console script, cross-platform launchers, CI matrix, business brief, compliance mapping, threat model and launch kit

[6/6] Verification: 73 tests pass; AIKit 4/4 gates pass; package install and console script smoke; all three launchers smoke-tested. checklists: passed. Delivery not authorized: 5 modified, 13 untracked.

handoff.state: 73 tests, 4/4 gates, project complete in working tree
handoff.next: commit and publish only after explicit authorization

checkpoints.description: [1/4] Anchor format and journal: canonical anchor payload, strict field validation, append-only journal chained by prev+hash, reader that reports tamper and rollback. [2/4] 'assay anchor' command: verify the ledger first, refuse a broken or empty chain, append {ledger, seq, head, created_at, key_id}. [3/4] 'assay verify --anchors FILE': cross-check every anchored head against the ledger so tail truncation and a full rewrite exit 1. [4/4] Key id and rotation format, published anchor test vector, ADR-006, docs/SECURITY.md and README roadmap, Phase 4 gates.

impact_assessment.why: The hash chain cannot detect tail truncation or a full rewrite, and docs/SECURITY.md plus ADR-002 both name head anchoring as the first enterprise gap; roadmap item 1 asks for it with a key id and rotation format.
impact_assessment.benefits: An anchored head proves the ledger reached a known seq/hash; truncation and whole-chain rewrites become detectable offline with the standard library, completing the evidence story the product already claims.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: a new on-disk anchor format and two CLI surfaces (anchor, verify --anchors); dependency: none, standard library only; concurrency: a second append-only file with the same single-writer assumption as the ledger; state: new anchor journal plus optional key id, no change to existing records; perf: one extra read of ledger and journal on verify
impact_assessment.mitigation: Strict canonical payload with unknown-field refusal and a published test vector; failing-first tests for tamper, deletion, seq rollback, truncation and rewrite; reuse append_line/fsync and tail reads; keep anchors strictly additive so existing ledgers verify unchanged; ADR and security docs updated before delivery; Phase 4 gates

checkpoints.description: [4/4] Head anchoring with key id and rotation, published anchor test vector, verify cross-checks, ADR-006, docs and tests; checklists: passed

[1/4] Core adapter layer: assay/adapters.py with pure standard-library transformers for MCP, OpenAI, LangGraph, and CrewAI schemas. [2/4] CLI integration: expand 'assay ingest --format' with openai, langgraph, crewai in assay/cli.py. [3/4] Tests & fixtures: test_adapters.py with fixture streams for each framework, edge cases, malformed inputs. [4/4] ADR-007, documentation guides, export in __init__.py, Phase 4 gates.

impact_assessment.why: Agent frameworks (OpenAI, LangGraph, CrewAI, MCP) emit distinct event telemetry; native adapters eliminate custom glue code and standardize evidence fields.
impact_assessment.benefits: Zero-dependency ingestion for top 4 agent ecosystems via CLI flags and Python helpers; enables 5-line evidence recording.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new adapters module and CLI choices; dependency: none (standard library only); concurrency: stateless transformers; state: creates standard Event records without ledger schema changes
impact_assessment.mitigation: Duck-typing dictionary inputs with schema validation; failing-first tests across framework sample outputs; strict AST and Phase 4 gates

checkpoints.description: [4/4] Agent framework adapters (OpenAI, LangGraph, CrewAI, MCP), CLI ingest formats, ADR-007, documentation; checklists: passed
